verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own materials say users can swap models and list 'Dynamic Model Selection'. Community users report running both local and API models (GPT-4o, Ollama, Hugging Face) and choosing between open-source and closed models. That shows multi-provider support, but the evidence never names the specific providers in the story or documents how model switching works. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Anthropic, Google, and OpenRouter provider support, documented per-conversation or per-workspace model switching, documented per-agent model assignment, and independent hands-on confirmation of switching.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: Swap models, configure permissions, set up custom agent workflows
a no-fuss way to use LLMs both locally and via APIs
